Three orientations

Scope

0° places pin 1 at top-left, on the west edge. Positive angles are clockwise. All leads extend 5 mm beyond the package edge; free wires start at their tips. Odd header pins are west of even pins on both banks. Official RBZM-1 is the adopted pinout, with RBZ_VDD on L14/R15 and GND on R1. The archived proposal is for comparison only and is electrically incompatible. RGB order can be tested independently. Extra-curved wires have a length-weighted straight departure and a longer tangent along the extended pin axis. Curve choices do not change the straight-chord metrics.

Power and ground guides are optional. Header pads stay visible when nets are unchecked; hovering an unchecked pad temporarily previews its wires. Local boot flash, level shifter and VISIBLE gate placement are not assumed. RBZM_ID is open on Caravel. GEN_TEXb and REG connect directly as requested.
